Package com.irurueta.authserver.bff.infrastructure.resourceserver

Class StepUpChallengeMapper

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.bff.infrastructure.resourceserver.StepUpChallengeMapper
@Component public class StepUpChallengeMapper extends Object
Maps the WWW-Authenticate challenge of a 401 answer of the resource server onto the domain: a bearer challenge with error="insufficient_user_authentication" (RFC 9470) becomes a DocumentsStepUpRequiredException carrying its acr_values and max_age. Any other challenge, or none, is not a step-up request.

    • toException

      public Optional<DocumentsStepUpRequiredException> toException(org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders headers, Throwable cause)
      Reads the step-up request of a 401 answer, if it is one.
      Parameters:
      headers - headers of the answer; null when it had none.
      cause - the failure to keep as the cause of the domain exception.
      Returns:
      the step-up request, or empty when the answer carries no step-up challenge.
